planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; pins D2, D3 are button inputs, D4/D5 are TM1637 CLK/DIO, D6 is a tone/beeper output as per resolved hardware configuration.
No explicit pullup/active polarity wiring is provided in the source; digital_input initial/model is set to true (pressed) to avoid double-inverting active-low in the model.
TM1637 display is treated as an integer seconds remaining value; exact initial countdown duration is a SysML/model parameter and is not specified here, so display initial is set to 0.

Beep behavior (continuous 2 seconds at the end of countdown, including whether tone frequency is fixed or controlled) is implemented in SysML using elapsed_ms; this request only provides the single tone channel on D6.
No serial reporting or serial command inputs were requested; therefore serial_channels is empty.
Control period chosen as 5 ms as a scheduling granularity suitable for button sampling and display/actuation updates.

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Beep output for continuous 2s alarm at countdown end

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 构建一个倒计时提醒系统，使用 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、按钮 D3 和蜂鸣器 D6。D2 用于增加倒计时时间（每次加 10 秒），D3 用于开始倒计时；数码管显示剩余秒数，结束时蜂鸣器连续鸣叫 2 秒。
